prompt.zh-TW: 課程參考值是負債比率不超過 {{percent:0.5|digits=0}}。星橋物流是一家有自有車隊和倉庫的物流公司，年底負債總額 {{money:vars.liabilities}}、資產總計 {{money:vars.assets}}，負債比率 {{percent:vars.ratio}}（見上表）。哪一個判讀最站得住腳？
prompt.en: The course reference value is a debt ratio of no more than {{percent:0.5|digits=0}}. Starbridge Logistics, a logistics company with its own fleet and warehouses, has total liabilities of {{money:vars.liabilities}} and total assets of {{money:vars.assets}} at year end, a debt ratio of {{percent:vars.ratio}} (see the table above). Which reading holds up best?

text.zh-TW: 高於參考值值得追問，但參考值不是法規門檻，要和同業比較
text.en: Being above the reference value is worth a question, but it is not a legal threshold; compare with peers

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。參考值是提醒你「該多問一句」的訊號，例如負債的內容與到期日，而不是結論。
feedback.en: That’s right. A reference value is a signal to ask one more question, such as what the debts are and when they fall due, not a conclusion.

text.zh-TW: 超過參考值就違反了規定，公司要在年底前把比率降到參考值以下
text.en: Exceeding the reference value breaks the rules, so the company has to bring the ratio below it by year end

feedback.zh-TW: 你把參考值看得很認真，這份謹慎是好的。不過參考值是課程整理的經驗值，法規並沒有規定一般公司負債比率的上限。
feedback.en: You take the reference value seriously, and that caution is good. But it is a rule of thumb compiled by the course; the law sets no ceiling on the debt ratio of an ordinary company.

text.zh-TW: 物流業也該套用同一個參考值，高於它就表示財務已經有危險
text.en: Logistics should use the same reference value, so being above it means the company is already in danger

feedback.zh-TW: 不同產業的資產結構差很多：車隊、倉庫這類資本密集的生意，負債比率普遍偏高。要和同業比，而不是只和一個通用數字比。
feedback.en: Asset structures differ widely between industries: capital-intensive businesses with fleets and warehouses commonly carry higher debt ratios. Compare with peers rather than a single universal number.

explanation.zh-TW: 課程參考值只是判讀的起點，網站不拿它計分。{{option:o_c3sa}}拿它來決定要追問什麼；{{option:o_py2p}}把經驗值當成法規，{{option:o_zfc4}}忽略了產業差異。
explanation.en: A course reference value is only a starting point for reading the ratio, and the site never scores against it. {{option:o_c3sa}} uses it to decide what to ask next; {{option:o_py2p}} mistakes a rule of thumb for law, and {{option:o_zfc4}} ignores industry differences.
